# Structural Literacy

Second chapter content goes here.

Figures work with plain Markdown image syntax — no raw LaTeX needed (unlike captioned tables). Caption placement below the image is Pandoc's normal default here, no override required the way tables needed one.

![Placeholder logo, used throughout this book's title
page.](logo-placeholder.png){#fig-logo width="40%"}

As with tables, a `fig-` prefixed label makes a figure cross-referenceable — @fig-logo above resolves automatically to
"Figure 3.1" and stays correct if figures get added or reordered.

To force a page break within a chapter (not needed between chapters — that happens automatically), use:

{{< pagebreak >}}

Content after the break starts on a fresh page.

```{=latex}
% \backmatter fires a \clearpage of its own, so — same lesson as
% \mainmatter/\giEnableMainMatter earlier — it needs to execute
% BEFORE the next chapter's heading, not after. Any raw LaTeX
% Quarto finds before a heading inside a .qmd file gets moved to
% after it, so this switch lives at the true end of this file
% (the last chapter before back matter) rather than at the top of
% closing.qmd. \giEnableBackMatter calls \backmatter and switches
% page numbering back to roman, continuing from where front matter
% left off (see \giMarkFrontMatterEnd in contents.qmd) rather than
% restarting at "i".
\giEnableBackMatter
```
